description: This file contains unit tests for the 'Device' class in the 'org.eclipse.hono.service.management.device' package. It verifies JSON serialization/deserialization, especially focusing on the 'enabled' flag and 'ext' extensions.

classes.name: DeviceTest
classes.description: Unit test class for the 'Device' model, testing JSON encoding/decoding behavior.

methods.name: testDecodeDefault
methods.description: Tests deserialization of a Device from an empty JSON object, expecting 'enabled' to be null.

methods.name: testDecodeDisabled
methods.description: Tests deserialization with 'enabled' set to false.

methods.name: testDecodeEnabled
methods.description: Tests deserialization with 'enabled' set to true.

methods.name: testDecodeExt
methods.description: Tests deserialization with an 'ext' extension map.

methods.name: testEncodeDefault
methods.description: Tests encoding a default Device instance to JSON, expecting no 'enabled' or 'ext' fields.

methods.name: testEncodeEnabled
methods.description: Tests encoding a Device with 'enabled' set to true.

methods.name: testEncodeDisabled
methods.description: Tests encoding a Device with 'enabled' set to false.
